summary: Lead review of the final head: the session-summary proofs judge behavior, not host speed. Removed wall-clock assertions reappear as contract bounds (drainBound per rows and elapsed time) or behavior checks (rows visible, revision and dirty state, fallback counts, completion); the live-churn schedule is exact (2 appends per 3 s) and a scanned-row correction must trigger the ledger_mutation fallback. The one product change is a proof-only read deadline gated by PLIMSOLL_PROOF_ROOT; production keeps 250 ms. CI proof green on 762ffb0f; Codex review of this head clean.
